corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez enclitic particle -ሰ ('ጻድቅሰ በአማን የሐዩ' - 'but the righteous shall live by faith'); the glyph ሰ was misread as አ due to ink bleed.
Ge'ez plural relative pronoun እለ ('and those who thirst'); 6th-order እ was misread as 1st-order አ.
Stage-1 OCR hallucinated non-Ethiopic (Arabic) script inside the Ge'ez word ነቢይ ('prophet').
Canonical Ge'ez citation from Isaiah 63:1 ('መኑ ዝ ይወጽእ እምኤዶም' - 'Who is this that comes from Edom?'); ኑዝ was misread as ካህ.
Standard Andemta term መተርጕም ('the interpreter/commentator'); the initial መ was misread as ጠ due to ink bleed closing the loops.
Amharic conjunction እንደ ('እንደ ተረጐመው' - 'as he interpreted it'); ደ with a faded right leg was misread as ያ.
Standard Ethiopic full stop (አራት ነጥብ ።) at the end of the verse was misread as a colon and angle bracket.
Ge'ez interrogative እፎኑመ ('why then?') wraps across lines 31 and 32.
